command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_uia_names.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=os.environ.copy())
win=None
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        if proc.poll() is not None: break
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(ws)==1:
            win=ws[0]; break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win: raise RuntimeError("flyExplorer window missing")
    time.sleep(4)
    files=[x for x in win.descendants() if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"]
    print("LEFTFILES_COUNT",len(files),flush=True)
    if len(files)!=1: raise RuntimeError("LeftFiles control ambiguous")
    rows=[x for x in files[0].descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]
    print("ROW_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    for i,row in enumerate(rows[:120]):
        try:
            name=row.element_info.name or row.window_text()
            rect=row.rectangle()
            imgs=[x.element_info.name for x in row.descendants()
                  if x.element_info.control_type=="Image"]
            print("ROW",i,repr(name),"RECT",(rect.left,rect.top,rect.width(),rect.height()),
                  "IMAGES",repr(imgs),flush=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print("ROW_ERROR",i,repr(e),flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if win is not None:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try: proc.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
        else:
            proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
print("EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
